committee.sub: Morning brief · Monday 12 October 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: The landing-page test has spent $111.90 ex-GST across 18 raw paid clicks (cost per click $6.17 over the last 7 days) with zero conversions recorded yet, leaving $433.91 of the promo credit before it expires 1 Dec.

Click-through rate fell to 1.9% this week from 3.9% even though impressions nearly doubled (1,084 vs 615 prior week), a mechanics shift worth watching as clicks build toward the 25-click freeze point.

The dedicated page has logged 18 raw paid clicks and 3 ask_cta_click events but no review_cta_click and no generate_lead yet, so it is still inside the pre-freeze review window with no qualified signal either way.

AI Assistant sessions rose to 4 this week (from 0), with claude-check the top source, a genuine answer-engine signal; Organic Search also strengthened to 18 sessions (from 6), while Direct fell from 33 to 14 and should not be read as new demand.

actions.text: Review search terms and Clarity recordings for the 18 raw paid clicks logged so far (inside the 10-20 checkpoint window) and log any exclusions now while edits are still allowed.
Standing: logo and image assets are still outstanding for the serving Agency and Job Intake ad groups.
Standing: RSA descriptions on the non-Agency ads still claim 13.3 hours of admin per week and 99.6% success; update these to match current site stats.
